meaning: A short way to type that something is funny. The three letters stand for three words.
clues: You type it when something makes you laugh.
It is made of three letters, all capitals.
It began in the early days of online chat and was later used in texts.
The letters stand for the words "laughing out loud."
Its first and last letters are the same, and the first one is L.

decoys.meaning: Short for "be right back." People type it when they step away for a moment.
Short for "oh my God." People type it to show they are surprised.
Short for "for your information." People type it before a useful fact.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, we wrote "ha ha" in the margin of a note. Now it is three letters, and people may not even be laughing!

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: True. Often it just sounds friendly. If you are unsure, read the message in a kind voice.
